items.statement: Establish written procedures that facilitate recalling defective finished drug products from the market, and follow them.
items.quote: manufacturers must establish and follow written procedures to facilitate the recall of defective products from the market

items.statement: Where an OTC drug is approved in a new drug application, report its quality defects to FDA.
items.quote: Manufacturers of OTC drugs approved in a new drug application are required to report quality defects
items.condition: OTC drug approved in a new drug application

items.statement: Establish and follow written procedures for periodic review of complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations of product discrepancies.
items.quote: manufacturers must establish and follow written procedures for periodically reviewing complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations of product discrepancies.
